sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.15 "DCMIPP common frame counter register (DCMIPP_CMFRCR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1911.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x208
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 FRMCNT[31:0]: Frame counter, read-only, loops around.
Incremented following VSYNC detection mapped to the pipe configured into bits PSFC[1:0]
of the DCMIPP_CMCR register. The counter is cleared using clear frame counter (CFC) bit
of DCMIPP_CMCR register.
